Whether student S2026CS003 can receive a hall ticket for all end-semester exams depends on two conditions:

1. **Fee Payment:** The examination fee for the term must be fully paid in the fee ledger [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5].
2. **Attendance:** The student must meet the minimum attendance requirement of at least 75% in each registered course, or have an approved condonation for any course where attendance is lower [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2; Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5].

The provided documents do not contain information regarding the specific fee balance or the current attendance percentage for student S2026CS003. Therefore, it cannot be determined if they will receive a hall ticket for all exams. If the student has not met the attendance requirement or has not received a condonation, they will be detained in those specific courses, and those courses will be left off the hall ticket [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4; Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5].
